Name: This Isn't My Farmhouse
Author: heathinwillows
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]hello^^ i made this mod for my friend ari and I thought I should share it with you guys (っ´ω`c)♡[/color]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ydRumKt.jpeg[/img]
[color=#d4d4d8]this is a medium or i guess small farmhouse still that won't make you stress much on decorating [/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]this farmhouse only has 2 renovations:[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]build/remove crib[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]and a sunroom attic[/color]

this farmhouse also features a bathroom with working mirror and bath tub, and along with it- the basement can also be used as a cask area

a note:

when making a new save, some of the pre placed furnitures aren't aligned on purpose to avoid furniture clipping issues like so:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OXXspNq.png[/img]

you could just fix them up yourself like this:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/N3vNNf4.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0as8cvd.png[/img]

i wouldn't be able to finish this mod without @fireredlily's help from this sdv discord, and also to chu as well (っ´ω`c)♡ so thanks you thanks you guys so much(⁠◍⁠•⁠ᴗ⁠•⁠◍⁠)⁠❤
